summary.business_type: Outdoor Adventure Activity Provider (SAB + Fixed Location) — Gorges du Verdon, France
top_findings: robots.txt and sitemap.xml both return HTTP 500 — search engines cannot crawl the site
Only 1 URL indexed by Google (entire site effectively invisible in search)
Duplicate title tags across all pages — every page uses the homepage title
Zero structured data (schema markup) on any page
NAP inconsistency: Castellane on site vs. La Palud-sur-Verdon in all external directories
quick_wins: Fix robots.txt → 200 response with valid content
Generate and submit XML sitemap via Google Search Console
Write unique title tags for each page (biggest ranking impact)
Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema to homepage
Display TripAdvisor reviews (#3/19, 54 reviews) on website

findings.title: robots.txt returns HTTP 500
findings.description: Server returns 500 Internal Server Error at /robots.txt — Googlebot cannot read crawl rules
findings.recommendation: Serve a valid static robots.txt at the domain root with Allow: / and Sitemap: pointer

findings.title: sitemap.xml returns HTTP 500
findings.description: Both /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml return 500 errors — Google has no URL list
findings.recommendation: Generate XML sitemap covering all canonical pages and submit to Google Search Console

findings.title: Only 1 URL indexed by Google
findings.description: site:linstantverdon.com returns 1 result — entire site invisible to search engines
findings.recommendation: Fix sitemap + canonicals + old URL redirects, then request indexing via GSC

findings.title: No canonical URLs on any page
findings.description: No <link rel='canonical'> found on homepage, service pages, blog, or FAQ pages
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonical to every page

findings.title: No hreflang implementation
findings.description: Bilingual site (fr/en) has no hreflang — Google can't determine language targeting
findings.recommendation: Add hreflang tags for fr, en, and x-default on all page pairs

findings.title: Old URL structure still in Google index
findings.description: Search results show /canyon/, /canyon/1, /en/canyon/ — old structure without 301 redirects
findings.recommendation: Implement 301 redirects from all old URLs to new canonical paths

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Blog posts have unique descriptive titles
Navigation menu is consistent and logical
Blog posts link back to service pages

findings.title: Duplicate title tags across all pages
findings.description: Every page uses 'L'instant Verdon | Canyoning, Aquarando & Escalade dans le Verdon' — only blog posts differ
findings.recommendation: Write unique keyword-rich titles for every page (50–60 chars)

findings.title: Missing meta descriptions on almost all pages
findings.description: Only /fr/a-propos has a meta description. All other pages auto-generate snippets.
findings.recommendation: Write 150–160 char meta descriptions for every page

findings.title: 5 H1 tags on homepage
findings.description: Homepage has 5 separate H1 elements diluting topic focus
findings.recommendation: Keep one H1 per page, demote others to H2/H3

findings.title: Poor image alt texts
findings.description: Logo and author photos use file paths as alt text
findings.recommendation: Write descriptive alt text for all images including keywords and context

findings.title: Blog posts critically thin (320–350 words)
findings.description: Both articles are far below 1,200-word minimum for informational query ranking
findings.recommendation: Expand each blog post to 1,000–1,500+ words with practical details, FAQs, and author voice

findings.title: FAQ page has only 3 questions
findings.description: Industry standard is 15–25 FAQs for activity providers
findings.recommendation: Expand FAQ to cover age minimums, weather policy, equipment, group sizes, meeting points

findings.title: No customer reviews displayed on website
findings.description: TripAdvisor #3/19 with 54 reviews not featured anywhere on the site
findings.recommendation: Add reviews section on homepage with aggregate rating and 3–5 featured reviews

findings.title: Zero structured data on entire site
findings.description: No JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa found on any page — no rich results possible
findings.recommendation: Implement LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, Article, Person, BreadcrumbList schemas

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Modern framework (appears to be Next.js or Nuxt)

findings.title: No CrUX field data available
findings.description: Performance estimated — run PageSpeed Insights for real lab/field data
findings.recommendation: Run https://pagespeed.web.dev/ — target mobile score 70+

findings.title: Image paths contain spaces
findings.description: /assets/a propos/ path has a space — risk of URL encoding errors
findings.recommendation: Rename directory to /assets/a-propos/ and update all references

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Listed in regional tourism directories (brand mention signals)

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) cannot discover site content map
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt listing key pages and business description

findings.title: Content not structured for AI citability
findings.description: No answer-first passages, thin FAQ, no citation capsules
findings.recommendation: Restructure service pages and FAQ for direct-answer quotability

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: TripAdvisor #3/19 in La Palud-sur-Verdon with 54 reviews

findings.title: NAP inconsistency — two different addresses
findings.description: Site: Castellane. All directories: La Palud-sur-Verdon. Google cannot reconcile.
findings.recommendation: Pick one address and update all listings to match

findings.title: No booking platform integration
findings.description: Not listed on FunBooker, CheckYeti, GetYourGuide, Viator — competitors rank here
findings.recommendation: Get listed on major French/international activity aggregators

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP format used — correct modern choice
Blog article images have descriptive alt text

findings.title: Logo alt text is file path
findings.description: alt='/assets/accueil/logo.webp' — not descriptive or keyword-rich
findings.recommendation: Use: alt='L'Instant Verdon — Guide Canyoning & Escalade Verdon'

findings.title: Activity images missing descriptive alt text
findings.description: Canyon and climbing images on service pages lack descriptive alt attributes
findings.recommendation: Write keyword + location alt text for every image

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix robots.txt — return 200 with valid content
Generate and submit XML sitemap to Google Search Console
Add canonical URLs to all pages
Implement 301 redirects from old URL structure
Confirm www → non-www redirect
Resolve NAP address inconsistency

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Write unique title tags for all pages
Write meta descriptions for all pages
Fix H1 structure — one H1 per page
Fix all image alt texts
Implement hreflang fr/en/x-default
Add LocalBusiness + AggregateRating JSON-LD schema
Add Service schema to all activity pages
Add FAQPage schema
Add Article schema to blog posts
Display TripAdvisor reviews on homepage

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand both blog posts to 1,200+ words
Expand FAQ to 20+ questions
Publish 2 new blog posts (pillar: canyoning guide, family guide)
Create /fr/avis page with reviews
Add difficulty ratings to all activity listings
Create llms.txt file
Get listed on FunBooker, CheckYeti, GetYourGuide, Viator

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor Google Search Console coverage weekly
Track organic traffic growth in GA4
Run PageSpeed Insights monthly
Publish 2 blog posts per month (1,000+ words each)
Actively request Google Reviews from customers
Monitor TripAdvisor rank and respond to all reviews
